summary: Decimal-safe money migration regression check. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_decimal_money_migration.py covering: single-service quote (emergency+GST reconciliation), multi-service cart-quote (qty>1 + 2 services, per-order fees applied once, total reconciles), partner /wallet + /earnings-summary 2dp + math consistency (gross-tax-net==platform_commission), partner withdrawal UPI reject 400, merchant /wallet (nested summary) 2dp + total_earned==referral+customer, merchant withdrawal UPI reject 400, guest cart-quote no-500 safety. All 8 pytest cases PASSED. No 500s, no Decimal-vs-float TypeErrors observed. Previous CommissionEngine full-lifecycle test (commission_engine_decimal_safe.json, 22/22) still valid — earnings-summary math re-verified against live ledger.

minor.issue: Cross-endpoint inconsistency in GST base: engines.PricingEngine.compute EXCLUDES visiting_charge from `taxable` (spec: VC is a reimbursement, not a taxable supply), but controllers.booking_controller.cart_quote sets taxable = subtotal + conv + plat where subtotal INCLUDES visiting_charge → GST is charged on VC in cart-quote. Pre-existing (not caused by Decimal migration) but the migration is a good time to align. Both totals still self-reconcile within their own endpoint.

action_items: OPTIONAL/PRE-EXISTING: Align GST tax base between single-service quote (VC excluded) and cart-quote (VC currently included) — decide the intended semantic and update the other side. Not a Decimal-migration blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: money.py helpers are clean and self-consistent (ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal via str). Good.
engines.PricingEngine.compute: taxable EXCLUDES visiting_charge (matches spec comment on line 168-170).

booking_controller.cart_quote (line 324): taxable = subtotal + conv + plat, and subtotal already includes visiting_charge → VC ends up in the tax base. Divergence from PricingEngine.compute. Recommend either (a) taxable = subtotal - visiting_charge + conv + plat, or (b) update spec/single-quote to include VC. Total math still balances within cart_quote itself.
partner_service.request_withdrawal: correctly rejects non-bank methods with 400 (UPI removed). Good.
merchant_wallet_service.request_withdrawal: same UPI rejection path via `method not in ('bank','cheque')`. Good.
partner_service.wallet_summary + earnings_summary: all outputs quantized via money.money/money.add — verified 2dp in live response.
test_credentials: Demo OTP 123456 for +919000000000 (admin), +919000000002 (merchant), +919000000003 (partner), +919000000004 (customer) — as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only on money math except for the UPI-rejection POSTs which fail-fast at validation with no side-effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For a fuller end-to-end regression run the previous test file test_engine_direct/test_visiting_charge_tax and the earlier commission_engine_decimal_safe run (22/22 passed) alongside test_decimal_money_migration.py. The pre-existing VC-in-cart-quote-tax vs VC-not-in-single-quote-tax inconsistency is documented under backend_issues.minor and is NOT a Decimal-migration regression.
